message.content: Research is a domain targeted by coding agent skills, as indicated by the claude-skills collection that lists research among its supported areas. The evaluation of proactive agents, itself a research activity, benefits from benchmarks like UniClawBench designed to assess real-world task performance. Cultural research, exemplified by the Hofstede model, builds on cumulative conceptual and empirical efforts to produce dimensional frameworks.
